card.title: Director, Quality Improvement
card.description:
**Position Purpose:**
 
Lead and direct process improvement activities that provide more efficient and streamlined workflow. 
**Key Details:** Must reside in Indiana or be willing to relocate to Indiana.

 

* Responsible for leading and collaborating with others on National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation and/or Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) performance

 

* Responsible for quality improvement aspects of risk adjustment processes for all products

 

* Collaborate with Medicare STARS team to improve overall STARS ratings for Medicare products (including HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS)

 

* Oversee provider satisfaction surveys and implement action plans for improvements

 

* Research and incorporate best practices into operations

 

* Organize and control activities, methods, and procedures to achieve business objectives

 

* Review and implement new technological tools and processes and fosters team concept with internal and external constituencies

 

* Present results of improvement efforts and ongoing performance measures to senior management

 

* Formulate and establish policies, operating procedures, and goals in compliance with internal and external guidelines

 

* Collaborate with State, County, and local agencies to promote services that improve health outcomes, decrease health disparities and reduce the cost of care.

 

* Work closely with State, County and local agencies, community stakeholders and communities to monitor the application of all standards

 

* Promote an environment of cultural competence throughout the health plan through identification and implementation of culturally-inclusive best practices and innovations, such as the development of provider trainings to improve cultural awareness and competency within the provider network

 

* Oversee the assessment of cultural diversity of the provider network to identify resources and gaps, including needs analysis for non-traditional providers (traditional healers, religious and spiritual resources, natural support systems, etc.) and develops recommendations for credentialing and network development activities.

 

* Monitor and evaluate provider practices through KPIs within health equity dashboards to assess and improve the cultural competence of delivered services by addressing care gaps and aligning interventions to resolve.

 

* Oversee the population specific activities (such as training, awareness through the media, and partnering with various external equity stakeholders), including cultural treatment teams and other cultural community support system activities.

 

* Oversee the comprehensive, outcomes-based Cultural Competency Plan that is aligned with CLAS standards and national and regional priorities/initiatives.

 

* The plan also incorporates data-driven assessments of culturally competent performance, and defines a strategy for the continual provision, monitoring and improvement of culturally competent performance.

 

* Manage outreach budget for Cultural Competency programs and sponsorships.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

 

* Complies with all policies and standards.

**Education/Experience:**
 
 
Bachelor's Degree Nursing, other related field or equivalent experience required 
 
**Master's Degree preferred:**

7+ years of quality management, quality improvement or healthcare operations experience required 
 
**Licenses/Certifications:**
 
 
Certain states may require a formal certification in quality improvement, risk management, or another parallel field. 
Current state’s RN license preferred 
 
**Certified Professional in Health Care Quality preferred**

Pay Range: $107,700.00 - $199,300.00 per year

**At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.** You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

card.title: Commissioning Director
card.description:
**About Us**

Clayco is a full-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power & energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports & entertainment related building projects.

**The Role We Want You For**

As the Commissioning Director, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and executing all commissioning activities on-site. Your leadership will ensure that every project is completed efficiently, effectively, and to the highest standards of quality and safety. This role demands extreme ownership and a proactive approach to managing complex commissioning processes.

**The Specifics of the Role**

 

* Develop and Implement Commissioning Plans: Create detailed commissioning plans, estimates, and schedules, ensuring all documentation is accurate and up to date. Engage with the owner early in the project for the development of systems and plant start up. Partner with process engineering in the development of plant turnover systems. Conduct Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) to further define commissioning plans.
* Oversee Daily Activities: Manage daily commissioning tasks on-site, ensuring timely and efficient completion of all activities.
* Coordinate with Teams: Collaborate with the Operations Team and Project Management to address schedule, budget, training, and any emerging issues.
* Inspect and Test Systems: Conduct thorough inspections and tests of equipment and systems to ensure compliance with safety policies and project requirements.
* Manage Deliveries: Coordinate equipment and material deliveries with vendors and subcontractors, ensuring alignment with project schedules.
* Ensure Quality and Timeliness: Perform commissioning activities to meet project delivery schedules, integrating third-party vendors and equipment suppliers effectively.
* Maintain Safety Standards: Uphold the highest safety standards throughout all commissioning processes.
* Provide Leadership: Lead and mentor the commissioning team, ensuring cohesive and effective execution of all tasks.
* Conduct Pre-Commissioning Inspections: Perform pre-commissioning and start-up inspections to confirm project readiness.
* Report Issues: Provide timely updates and reports on commissioning issues to all relevant parties.
* Project Completion Activities: Defines the split of responsibilities between Clayco, CSS, Project Management, and Client.
* Prepare for Client Transition: Prepare turnover packages and support the transition to the client after final inspections and commissioning are complete.
* System Testing: Conduct integrated system testing and compile results to ensure system functionality and performance.
* Additional Duties: Perform other related duties as needed.

**Requirements**

 

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: 15-25 years of experience in construction, commissioning, start-up, and operations on large-scale projects.
* Certifications: ANSI CX certification is a plus.
* Specialized Experience: Experience in data center commissioning and Building Automation Systems (Controls) is highly desirable.
* Skills: Proficient in creating, reviewing, and presenting reports related to commissioning activities. Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing commissioning plans for large-scale construction projects.

**Some Things You Should Know**

 

* Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required.
* No other builder can offer the collaborative design-build approach that Clayco does.
* We work on creative, complex, award-winning, high-profile jobs.
* The pace is fast!
* This position is classified as a safety-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing.

**Why Clayco?**

 

* 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal.
* 2025 ENR Midwest – Midwest Contractor (#1).
* 2025 ENR Top 100 Design-Build Firms – Design-Build Contractor (Top 5).
* 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3).
* 2025 ENR Top 25 Data Center Builders - Data Center Contractor (Top 3).

**Benefits**

 

* Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning & development programs and more!

**Compensation**

 

* The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

card.title: SR. DIRECTOR, QUALITY ASSURANCE
card.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
 
 
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
 
 
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
 
 
Let’s Get Loco!
 
 
What’s in it for you!
 
 

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:** 
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance owns El Pollo Loco's enterprise quality assurance function end to end, consolidating vendor-level quality assurance and regulatory food safety compliance into a single point of accountability. This role is responsible for the integrity of the supply chain's quality systems — from supplier and co-manufacturer qualification through regulatory compliance across federal, state, and local agencies — and serves as the primary quality and food safety resource to the franchise system.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
Vendor & Supplier Quality Assurance
 

* Directs vendor and supplier quality assurance programs across El Pollo Loco's poultry portfolio, including fresh leg quarters (“Saddles”) and value-added further-processed chicken items, ensuring specification integrity, ingredient consistency, and product quality at every stage of the supply chain.
* Leads vendor qualification, audit, scorecarding, and corrective-action programs; partners with Procurement and Distribution to resolve quality holds, non-conformances, and supplier performance issues.
* Owns quality specifications for co-manufactured and further-processed chicken products, working directly with processors to validate manufacturing controls, shelf-life, and food safety design prior to system-wide rollout.
* Evaluates and approves new vendors, ingredients, and product formulations, ensuring alignment with brand quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory & Food Safety Compliance
 

* Serves as the company's senior point of accountability for food safety regulatory compliance, including FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GFSI, and state and local health department requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
* Builds and maintains direct working relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies; leads the company's response to regulatory inquiries, inspections, and enforcement actions.
* Owns crisis management, product withdrawal, and recall protocols (including activation of the Level 3 Withdrawal Process), partnering with executive leadership and legal counsel as needed.
* Directs internal and third-party food safety audit programs spanning restaurants, distribution centers, and manufacturing partners.

Team Leadership & Franchise Support
 

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization spanning both vendor quality and regulatory food safety disciplines; sets performance expectations, coaching plans, and succession pipelines for direct reports.
* Serves as a critical QA partner to the franchise system, delivering training, technical guidance, and responsive support to franchisees on quality and food safety matters.
* Represents Quality Assurance in cross-functional and executive leadership forums, translating vendor and regulatory risk into clear, actionable guidance for Operations and senior leadership.
* Other duties as assigned by the SVP, Supply Chain & Quality Assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
 
 
**Education/Work Experience:** 
BA/BS in Food Science, Food Microbiology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 12+ years of progressive quality assurance and food safety experience, with substantial, direct experience in poultry and value-added/further-processed chicken products required. Demonstrated background working directly with state and federal regulatory agencies (FDA, USDA, state health departments) on compliance, inspections, or enforcement matters required. Prior experience directly managing and developing a quality assurance team required.
 
 
**License/Certifications:** 
Valid driver's license required. HACCP certification required; PCQI (Preventive Controls Qualified Individual) preferred.
 
 
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Proven track record building, managing, and developing high-performing quality assurance teams, with strong people-leadership, coaching, and succession-planning skills.
* Deep working knowledge of value-added and further-processed chicken manufacturing, including co-manufacturer oversight, specification management, and shelf-life validation.
* Established credibility with state and federal regulatory agencies; skilled at navigating inspections, audits, and enforcement proceedings with composure and precision.
* Demonstrated ability to support and train franchisees on quality and food safety standards, balancing brand protection with practical, field-level guidance.
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives; decisive and able to make fact-based decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners, including vendors, regulators, and franchisees.
* Ability to prioritize and plan competing, time-sensitive work assignments under frequent, tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex regulatory reports, contracts, and correspondence.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significant risk and consequence to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state vendor, distribution, and restaurant locations, as needed, by car or airplane.

Our Company
 
 
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable.
 
 
PAY DISCLAIMER – CA ONLY
 
The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. Individual pay decisions will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

This position provides leadership to Quality Engineering, Inspection, and other quality resources across Jered locations and ensures appropriate quality controls are integrated throughout engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, testing, delivery, and field service activities.

 + Proven ability to build, lead, develop, and hold accountable Quality Engineering and Inspection organizations.
 + Experience interfacing with U.S. Government representatives, including DCMA and SUPSHIP, as well as major shipyards and defense customers.

 + Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
 + Ability to obtain and maintain access to military installations, shipyards, and controlled industrial areas.

card.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.
* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

**Required Knowledge, SkillsAbilities:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, audit management, traceability, containment, and change control.
* Ability to prioritize multiple critical issues, assign ownership, allocate resources, and drive timely closure under production and customer pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills for interaction with the CEO, executive management, OEM customers, suppliers, and cross-functional leaders.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and corrective action effectiveness verification.
* Ability to evaluate complex quality risks from company-wide, customer, supplier, financial, operational, and business-continuity perspectives.
* Broad working knowledge of internal process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, quality systems, and automotive manufacturing operations.
* Strong executive leadership, organizational management, people development, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.

***AUTHORITYSCOPE***

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Yes. Provides overall leadership and direction for the PE Quality Control Department, including MIP process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality activities. Supervises assigned quality leaders and personnel and is responsible for work direction, priority setting, resource allocation, coaching, performance feedback, organizational capability, and escalation management in accordance with company policy.

***QUALIFICATIONS***

*(The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required and preferred for this position.)*

**Required EducationExperience:**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution.
* Five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality teams, cross-functional investigations, and major customer and/or supplier escalations.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* In lieu of a degree, there is a minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.
* Familiarity with occupational hazards and safety precautions.
* Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:** N/A

**Preferred Education, Experience, and Certified / Licenses:**

* Bachelor's Degree or more advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.**

Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.

Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.

Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.

As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives.

As a member of the QC leadership team in Milford, the Director, Quality Control Technical Services will manage and oversee a Quality Control team responsible for maintaining GxP systems and processes that support site business objectives; within QC this will be from Clinical Development to Clinical Supply and/or Commercial manufacture at a Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The candidate will work in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Supply Operations, Process Sciences and Quality Assurance to support continual improvement and cGMP compliance. The Director will work functionally as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team to support the development and approval of our clinical development programs, commercial operations, and implement strategic imperatives within a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

 

* Will manage teams of professionals within Quality Control encompassing raw materials testing, microbiology, QC LIMS master data and electronic systems, analytical equipment lifecycle management, documentation and data integrity
* Hire and develop employees within the department through coaching and mentorship while setting clear expectations for success
* Leads and manages the Milford Site QC Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
* Establish and maintain Quality Control systems and processes at Milford, MA site
* Develops and maintains department budgets (expense and capital) in alignment with overall organizational goals for profitability

* Acts as portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
* Represents QC at the project team level and interacts with Rentschler clients as needed
* Ensure timely execution of client projects and clear communications to clients
* Identify and initiate improvements to Quality Control Systems and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring compliance with all relevant quality standards and regulatory requirements
* Verify & establish department readiness for audits by both internal and external authorities, serve as primary Quality Control contact for regulatory inspections and client audits
* Analyze regulatory authorities’ programs, guidance documents and activities in areas relevant to testing biological products
* Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
* Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
* Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values

**Qualifications and Key Characteristics**

 

* BS required, MS preferred in a scientific/technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in a QC position within the biological and/or CDMO industry
* 10+ years in a management/leadership role(s)
* PhD in a scientific/technical discipline a plus
* Experience in microbiological methods and contamination control
* Subject matter experiment in laboratory equipment qualification and data management
* Ability to apply GMP regulations and international guidelines to all aspects of the position
* Experience with regulatory inspections and client audits specifically within a startup/early phase and commercial QC laboratories
* Extensive experience with writing and managing investigations and risk assessments
* Proficient in MS Office application suite as well GMP electronic applications such as LIMS
* Outstanding leadership abilities with demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills while managing high performing teams
* Proven leader, delegator, and decision maker with the ability to interact with all levels
* Executive presence with strong interpersonal and communication skills, verbal and written

**Working Conditions**

 

* Manufacturing environment with potential chemical, electrical and physical hazards
* Personal protective equipment must be worn in the laboratories according to Rentschler safety requirements
* Exposure to cool/hot storage conditions
* May be working in a loud area at times, that requires hearing protection and other protective equipment to be worn
* Working around chemicals such as solvents, acids, bases and reactive or flammable materials
* May require immunization before performing work within the manufacturing area
* Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high
* Some international travel (no more than 5% time)

**Physical Requirements**

 

* May be required to stand for long periods of time while performing physical duties
* May be required to lift up to 10 lbs
* Must be able to work safely with materials and equipment
* PPE as required

**Job Description**

**General Summary:**

The Senior Director, Device Quality provides strategic Quality leadership and oversight for Vertex device and combination product operations across development, manufacturing, testing, clinical, commercial, and post-market activities.

The role is accountable for **risk-based operational Quality oversight of internal activities and external partners** , including CDMOs, testing laboratories, and critical suppliers. The role ensures compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global device and combination product requirements.

The Senior Director serves as the **Management Representative for the Device QMS** , providing leadership for QMS effectiveness, regulatory compliance, management review, inspection readiness, and continual improvement. The role partners with senior Quality and business leaders on **enterprise Quality initiatives** .

 

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

• Define and execute the **Device Operational QA strategy** aligned with business, portfolio, and product priorities.

• Provide Quality oversight of **CDMOs, suppliers, testing laboratories, and other external partners** , including quality agreements, audits, performance, and risk management.

• Provide Quality oversight of **internal design control, design transfer, manufacturing, testing, and product realization activities** .

• Serve as **Management Representative** for the Device QMS, ensuring QMS effectiveness, management review, compliance, and continual improvement.

• Ensure compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global regulatory requirements.

• Provide strategic oversight of **deviations, investigations, CAPA, change control, complaints, supplier quality, audits, and inspection readiness** .

• Establish and monitor **Quality metrics, risks, trends, and performance** , driving timely escalation and resolution of significant issues.

• Provide Quality leadership for **regulatory inspections, notified body audits, product milestones, and launch readiness** .

• Partner with senior leaders on **enterprise-wide Quality initiatives** that improve compliance, operational effectiveness, and business performance.

**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. * Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

* All licensed, certified, and registered staff will be monitored regarding restrictions.

card.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location**

Carmel, IN • Memphis, TN • St. Louis, MO • Malden, MO • Peoria, IL • Other Illinois locations

**Leadership**

Directly manages at least two quality team members

**Travel**

Regular travel to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed

Weaver Popcorn is seeking a seasoned quality leader ready to step into a broader Director-level role. The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations. This leader will strengthen and standardize quality systems, develop quality talent, and partner with plant and business leaders to ensure products consistently meet company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced food manufacturing quality professional who can set direction while remaining actively engaged with plant teams, audits, investigations, corrective actions, and day-to-day execution.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Quality & Food Safety Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Develop and lead the company’s quality and food safety strategy, priorities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure quality assurance and food safety programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved.
* Establish and oversee grain and popcorn quality standards from grower receipt and bulk storage through processing, bagging, and shipment, ensuring consistent quality controls throughout the supply chain.
* Provide visible leadership on the manufacturing floor through routine plant engagement, risk reviews, verification activities, and follow-up on quality concerns.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.

**SQF, Audits & Regulatory Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and maintain SQF certification programs, including system ownership, audit preparation, certification readiness, corrective actions, and ongoing compliance.
* Plan, lead, and oversee internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits of food manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, and related verification activities.
* Lead cross-functional Food Safety/HACCP, risk assessment, prerequisite program, and food quality teams.
* Monitor applicable food safety and quality requirements and translate them into practical operating standards and controls.
* Ensure effective quality controls for bulk grain storage, bin holds and releases, sampling, testing, and corn disposition prior to processing, including compliance with applicable phytosanitary requirements.

**Quality Management Systems**
------------------------------

* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.
* Standardize quality documentation, specifications, procedures, policies, records, and reporting across facilities.
* Use quality data, trend analysis, and leading and lagging indicators to identify risk, establish priorities, and improve performance.
* Ensure effective controls for ingredient sampling, product verification, environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, traceability, and other core quality programs.
* Provide oversight of corn testing and laboratory quality programs, including mycotoxin testing, internal and third-party sample testing, review of test results, and appropriate product disposition based on quality and food safety requirements.

**People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a quality team of at least two direct reports, with potential for broader team responsibility as the function grows.
* Set clear goals, define accountabilities, assess performance, strengthen technical capability, and create development plans for quality team members.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Operations leaders to resolve quality issues without compromising food safety, customer requirements, or regulatory compliance.
* Establish and enforce hold/release and product disposition standards, with authority to stop processing or bagging operations and place grain, ingredients, or finished product on hold when food safety or quality requirements are not met.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Service to respond to customer documentation requests, audits, samples, complaints, and quality-related inquiries.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Oversee nonconforming material, product holds, rework, release, and disposition processes, partnering with Operations and suppliers to ensure timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear quality updates, risk assessments, recommendations, and performance reporting to senior leadership and other decision-makers.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor's degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or related fields.
* 8–10+ years of progressive quality or food safety experience in the food manufacturing industry.
* At least 5 years of people-management experience, including progressive supervisory and manager-level responsibility.
* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Consistent audit and certification readiness across facilities.
* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**
===============================

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Quality must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when operational, audit, customer, or food safety needs require support. Regular travel is expected based on business needs.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

================================

* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas.
